card.architecture: Qwen-Image 20B MMDiT edit model (Qwen2.5-VL encoder; dual semantic + appearance path)
card.summary: Clean instruction editor on the 20B Qwen-Image base, fp8 for near-bf16 quality. Strong character/scene consistency and text rendering. Offloads to RAM on 8GB (slow); declines explicit edits.
card.pick_when: Editing an existing image with clean, high-consistency SFW results; commercial OK; can wait.

prompt.guidance: Provide an input image + imperative instruction.
prompt.example: (with input image) Put a red baseball cap on her and change the background to a beach
prompt.overview: Plain natural-language edit instructions (English or Chinese). Supports semantic editing (high-level changes keeping identity) and appearance editing (precise local changes) -- phrase the instruction to match which you want.
prompt.instructions:
Two modes: semantic editing (high-level changes -- many pixels may change but identity/semantics stay: IP/character work, rotation/viewpoint, style transfer, composition) and appearance editing (precise local edits -- the rest stays untouched: add/remove/recolor a specific element).
General structure: '[action] the [object] to [result]'. Be specific and include context (e.g. 'add a signboard with reflection', not just 'add a signboard').
Strong identity/character consistency (2511 improves it and supports multi-person / multi-image -- describe the layout).
Text editing is a headline strength: bilingual, can add/delete/modify text while preserving font/size/style; quote the exact text and correct iteratively or region by region.
Break complex edits into sequential steps. Recommended (base): true_cfg_scale 4.0, negative_prompt ' ' (a single space), ~40-50 steps.
do: Write plain add/remove/change instructions (EN or ZH)
Match phrasing to semantic vs appearance intent
Quote exact text for text edits; correct iteratively
dont: Phrase a big semantic change when you meant a local one (and vice versa)
Cram many unrelated edits into one step
Omit context that disambiguates the target
examples: Change the rabbit's color to purple, with a flash light background.
Replace the headline text with 'GRAND OPENING' while keeping the same font, size and color.
prompt.negative_guidance: Official examples pass a single-space negative prompt (effectively none); no content-based negative guidance is given.

negative.note: Official usage passes a single-space negative (effectively none); the graph zeroes out the negative conditioning, so no user negative is consumed.

speed.measured_note: Qwen edit measured ~6.7-7.0GB VRAM peak; ~140s at 8 steps.

ui_help.note: Edits an existing image from an instruction; not used for from-scratch generation here.

edit_use_cases: high-quality SFW instruction editing on the 20B Qwen base: add/remove/replace, clothing/colour, background, relight; strong consistency and text

reference.hint: Your photo is image 1; your attached references are image 2 and image 3. Refer to them by number. Example: 'put the dress from image 2 on the person in image 1.'
